Package eu.cloudhopper.mc.provider.aws.blobstore

Class S3BlobStoreFactory

java.lang.Object
eu.cloudhopper.mc.provider.aws.blobstore.S3BlobStoreFactory
All Implemented Interfaces:
BlobStoreFactory
public class S3BlobStoreFactory extends Object implements BlobStoreFactory
Stores for S3 buckets, or for buckets of an S3-compatible object storage such as Scaleway Object Storage or MinIO. Configuration properties:
  • cloudhopper.bucket.<name>.name: the bucket's deployed name, set by the deployment; without it the name from @Bucket
  • cloudhopper.blobstore.s3.endpoint: the endpoint of an S3-compatible storage, e.g. https://s3.fr-par.scw.cloud; buckets are then addressed by path. Without it, S3 of the region, with the bucket in the host name
  • cloudhopper.blobstore.s3.region: the signing region; without it AWS_REGION
  • cloudhopper.blobstore.s3.access-key-id and cloudhopper.blobstore.s3.secret-access-key: the credentials of the object storage, e.g. a key of an S3-compatible storage; without them AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY and AWS_SESSION_TOKEN, which Lambda sets for the function's execution role
